The '''Lesser Houdoggin''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]],<ref name="Patterns" /> a desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> The creature had self-sealing [[Ear/Legends|earflaps]] that could block out sound in a similar manner to how many [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species closed their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Patterns" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] wished for earflaps similar to the Lesser Houdoggin's to block out the grating voice of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Imperial Sector Police]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Prefect (Coruscant police)/Legends|prefect]] [[Pol Haus]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Patterns" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lesser Houdoggin was first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]'', a [[2008]] novel that was written by [[Michael Reaves]]<ref name="Patterns" /> with help from [[Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff]].<ref name="Bohnhoff">{{WebCite|url=http://paperdragonink.com/?p=1817|text=Interview with Author Maya Kaathryn Bohnhoff >> Paper Dragon ink|author=Lentes, Douglas|date=2012-01-15, 9:39 pm|work=Paper Dragon ink|archivedate=20120120015419}}</ref>
